Actual corner projections define endpoint regions; each retained cap has actual plate contact. The entire remaining actual body is measured.

method.world_geometry: Indexed GLB triangles and recursive actual node TRS/matrices. No production drain fitter or authored ground function imported.
method.highest_support: Convex projected clipping plus height-plane crossing partitions; explicit uncovered cells retained.
method.base: Actual downward/upward faces vs actual highest ground, and actual bottom vs actual top thickness.
method.bars: Source endpoints only locate actual closed end-cap triangle pairs within measured float32 position bounds. Actual cap centers define the actual bar axis, avoiding direction amplification in short quantized cylinders. Each cap must have actual plate contact; actual vertex projections define the only endpoint regions. The complete actual body is checked by the exact piecewise affine lower clearance envelope across axial sections. Missing body intervals fail; visible body tops must remain above the base.
method.unique_step_fold: Only grate101/A05/edge1/anchor(-28,-35.2): actual plate top/bottom and vertical faces must continuously close each fold (actual step<=18mm); actual four-corner riser caps and all side faces form a closed connector whose end centers meet both actual ordinary bar caps and supported levels (actual step<=16mm). Ordinary support tolerance is unchanged.
method.unique_relocation: Only grate041/building809889629/edge1: bind the frozen 17cm source translation and retained wall-fixture anchor; independently measure actual exported base-to-curb projection clearance, complete bar-section footprint margin, and sole asphalt support. Required actual margins are 1cm.
method.coverage_precision: Only entire missing convex cells within two opposite actual closed edge bands, each bounded by transformed actual float32 half-ULPs and <=10um, with adjacent plane heights agreeing within computed coordinate-rounding bounds. No fixed small-area exemption.
method.source_binding: Current GLB hash, actual scene revision, source audit file hash and current three production-source hashes all bound.
